children: Germany greentech firm's preliminary H1 revenue nearly doubled yr/yr on Italian Hydrogen Valley orders
Preliminary H1 EBIT heavily impacted by EUR 19.8 mln non-cash impairment on Saerbeck campus
Company withdrew 2026 financial year guidance on Aug. 5, 2026
Enapter to publish updated outlook after validating 2026 and 2027 planning
Company preparing for capital increase in second half of 2026
ITALIAN HYDROGEN VALLEY ORDERS - Revenue growth in H1 was primarily driven by ongoing deliveries of megawatt-class systems for the Italian Hydrogen Valley Initiative
SAERBECK CAMPUS IMPAIRMENT - Preliminary EBIT was heavily affected by a non-cash impairment of EUR 19.8 mln on the Saerbeck campus
US SALES RESTRUCTURING - Company terminated US sales partner agreement after unpaid fees, plans new distribution partner
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the renewable fuels peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Enapter AG is €2.20, about 110.5% above its September 17 closing price of €1.05
